title: Envy-free proportional cake cutting with free disposal
area: Algorithmic game theory, mechanism design and fair division
formal: What is the optimal Robertson–Webb query complexity of producing an envy-free allocation in which every agent gets at least 1/n of her value for the whole cake, when unallocated cake is allowed and bundles may be disconnected?
context:
Assume nonatomic normalized nonnegative additive valuations on an interval. Complete cake allocation is a different target already recorded.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Tests whether discarding some divisible resource removes the main algorithmic cost of exact fairness.
